neighbours.label: the function word right after a topic-opening evaluative head noun ('Another important note [that]', 'One of the greatest dilemmas [of]', 'A final note [before]')
fire: Another useful trick that saves time is to label every box.
One of the hardest lessons of my career was learning to listen.
A quick reminder before we start the meeting today.
Another major obstacle in building the bridge was the weather.
The most surprising aspect of the trip for me was the food.
Another great feature about this phone is the battery life.
One more warning that hikers should remember concerns the river.
Another common mistake in baking bread is rushing the dough.
quiet: Labeling every box saves time when you move house.
Learning to listen took me most of my career.
We start the meeting today after a quick coffee.
The weather slowed the builders who worked on the bridge.
The food surprised me on the trip to Lisbon.
This phone lasts two days because the battery is large.
Hikers should remember that the river rises fast.
Rushing the dough ruins bread that could have been good.

notes: Probes: four openers of this shape 0.48-0.70; the same content without the opener 0.03-0.13. The + pole is the copula after 'and that' / a subject ('... and that [is]').
